selection_criteria: Dev strict pass rate, fewer errors, lower measured total API cost, lower median latency. No test results used.

experiments.hypothesis: Four page images and 24k characters may suffice for grounded multimodal answers.
Six page images, 48k characters and four retrieval actions may improve multi-page reasoning, at increased token cost.

Dev errors show source-component omissions, condition substitution and contradictory summaries. An opt-in generic source/condition verification prompt may fix them without changing retrieval parameters or gold.

historical_baseline_policy: Reuse base/wide runs: default prompt and retrieval behavior unchanged after opt-in dispatch. Retain old code hashes and validate actual system prompts; disclose historical code differences.
